Problem Statement:
boy rolls an unbiased die until he gets ‘1’. You are given a number n find the total sum of probability that he will get ‘1’ on or before nth trial.(Probability of getting 1 at 1 time + probability of getting 1 at 2 trial...+probability of getting 1 at nth trial) Constraints 1<=n<=1000 
Input Description:
You are given a number ‘n’. 
Output Description:
Print two numbers denoting numerator and denominator 
Explanation:
As n=1 this means he rolled the die once and he got the output Hence ⅙ is probability so numerator is 1 and denominator is 6 
Sample Input:
1 
Sample Output:
1 6
